title: Naturally Sweet French Apple Skillet
description: A sweet and crumbly French dish featuring chopped chives and dehydrated apples, perfect for a festive occasion, and is FODMAP-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large cast-iron skillet, combine the chopped apples and melted butter.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the almond flour, coconut sugar, eggs, vanilla extract, and salt.
Add the whisked mixture to the skillet with the apples and stir until combined.
Sprinkle the chopped chives on top of the mixture.
Bake the skillet in the preheated oven for 35 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Use a spatula to loosen the edges of the skillet and transfer it to a serving plate.
Serve the skillet warm, garnished with additional chopped chives if desired.
